change: Mixer design, source routing navigation and plugin parameter cards
notes: Preview windows and other build/test processes were stopped during this run. Audio processing and benchmark sources are unchanged; Cargo reused the existing benchmark binary.

Criterion reports a historical baseline change of +2.43% within its noise threshold and a telemetry regression of +1.73%. These measurements do not establish a causal connection to UI changes; this benchmark does not link the viewer.
Four channels; playback restarts every 180 blocks. Telemetry queues are consumed every 12 blocks, approximately 30 Hz.
This microbenchmark excludes GPUI layout, painting, plugin windows, routing model construction and device I/O. It does not measure UI frame rate, physical-device callback p95/p99 or xrun endurance.

Real GPUI captures separately cover dark/light layouts, compact piano controls, mixer routing navigation and independent inspector keyboard scrolling. Physical mouse/trackpad and native window interactions still require an unlocked desktop.
